artboards.title: Compliance matrix — with the source page open
Review verdict — override with a reason

annotations.text:
S4.0.1, draft 2 — built on the CrossBid design system (project b81312f6): its shell, tokens, Geist, NavItem / Button / Badge / Tag / MetricCard / VerdictChip / Tabs / Radio / Card anatomy, and the SVG logo lockup. Static mockups. UI in English; requirements explained in German; source quotes in French (the real TED 618320-2026 fixture). Company documents and figures are sample data.

Two places where the system's vocabulary and the plan's contracts differ — your call:
1. Verdicts. The system says Go / Conditional / No-go / Insufficient evidence. The backend's Decision enum says go / go_with_open_items / no_go. Conditional ≈ go_with_open_items; Insufficient evidence has no value yet (it is the agent refusing a verdict). Adopt the system's four and add the fourth to the enum?
2. Row evidence. The system says Supported / Partially supported / Unsupported. The backend's RowStatus says met / unclear / unmet / not_applicable. Mapped one-to-one here; not_applicable would show as a Tag.

The source page (S4.5.1's PDF-beside-the-matrix) opens as a 400 px panel to the right of the matrix rather than a permanent split — that is the one screen the system did not have.

The gate (docs/project-plan.md S4.0.1): nothing under components/matrix, components/pdf or components/verdict is coded until you confirm this canvas. Accepted changes are recorded in an ADR, and later UI stories cite the artboard they implement.
